description: This line plot, titled "Training Loss of 20M Data Size," illustrates the training loss over a sequence of steps for six different model configurations, each distinguished by color and marker style as indicated in the legend. The x-axis, labeled "Step," is displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0K to 440K, with tick marks at intervals of 20K (0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, 430K, 440K). The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," also uses a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 0.85, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 0.85). The six lines represent the following models: ChemBART Small 20M (red, solid line with circles), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue, solid line with circles), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green, solid line with circles), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange, solid line with circles), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple, solid line with circles), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown, solid line with circles). All lines begin at a high training loss value near 0.85 at step 0K and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a more gradual decrease toward a plateau near 0.05, which is reached by approximately step 40K. After this point, the lines remain relatively flat with minor fluctuations, indicating convergence. The ChemLLaMA models (purple and brown) consistently maintain the lowest loss values throughout the training process compared to the ChemBART and ChemBERTa models.
